To the Admissions Committee,  

I had the pleasure of engaging with Stefan Novakovic during a collaborative research initiative at our institution, where he contributed as a consultant to a health data interoperability project. As a professor, I observed his ability to bridge technical challenges with practical healthcare outcomes, a rare combination in the field.  

Stefan’s strength lies in his methodical problem-solving and commitment to precision. During the project, he led the design of a patient data aggregation tool that streamlined cross-institutional data sharing, reducing manual errors by over 40%. His approach balanced technical rigor with an understanding of clinical workflows, ensuring the solution met both operational and ethical standards. Beyond his technical acumen, he demonstrated exceptional collaboration skills, fostering trust among multidisciplinary teams despite differing priorities.  

A standout moment occurred when he identified a critical data latency issue in our prototype. Rather than propose a quick fix, he spent weeks refining an algorithm that improved real-time data accuracy without compromising system scalability. This attention to depth and long-term reliability set him apart.  

Stefan’s work ethic is marked by humility and intellectual curiosity. He consistently sought feedback, iterated on solutions, and mentored junior researchers with patience. His ability to navigate complex systems while maintaining clarity and empathy makes him a valuable asset.  

I am confident he will contribute meaningfully to your program.  

Sincerely,  
[Professor’s Name]  
[Institution]
